entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please say 'Support' or 'Sales' to continue.
Support.
Connecting you to the next available agent.
Thank you for holding. You've reached VeloFit, my name is Isaac. How can I help you today?
I need to return a VeloBand GPS Tracker.
I can certainly look into that for you. Do you have the order number handy?
Yes, it's VF88602. I received it 20 days ago.

Thank you. Pulling that up now... Okay, I see the order from December 15th. To understand the situation better, could you tell me what specifically is the issue? Is it a technical fault or more of a preference?
It's not for me. I just want my money back.

I understand. Normally, for a wearable device that's been out of the box for this long, our return **policy** can be quite strict. After a few weeks, it's often considered **too late** because of **hygiene** concerns and general **sanitation** standards for items worn on the skin.
Look, I don't need the whole speech. Can I return it or not? It's a simple question.

You are right, my apologies. Let me just check the exact terms that apply to your specific purchase date... one moment... Ah, okay. It seems your purchase falls under our previous 90-day return window. You're well within that timeframe.
Great. So you'll approve it?

Yes, absolutely. I've just processed the return authorization. I'm sending a prepaid shipping label to the email we have on file. Just package the VeloBand in its original box, attach the label, and you can drop it off at the post office.
Okay, fine. When do I get the refund?
Once our warehouse receives the item, your refund will be processed back to your original payment method within 3 to 5 business days.
Got it. Thanks.
You're very welcome. Is there anything else I can assist you with today?
No, that's it.
Alright. Thank you for calling VeloFit, and have a great rest of your day.
